en: The Buddha spoke the *Gao-wang Guanshiyin Jing*:
To Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. Homage to the Buddha. Homage to the Dharma. Homage to the Sangha. There is affinity with the Buddha-lands;
the Buddhadharma arises through causes and conditions. It is eternal, blissful, self, and pure. Having affinity with the Buddhadharma: Homage to Ma...
Praise be to the Prajñāpāramitā!
This is a great divine mantra.
Homage to the Mahāprajñāpāramitā!
This is the great vidyā-mantra.
Homage to the Mahāprajñāpāramitā!
This is the unsurpassed mantra.
Homage to the Mahāprajñāpāramitā.
This is the mantra of the Peerless One.
Homage to the Buddha Pure Light Secret.
The Buddha Dharmagupta;
the Buddha Siṃhanāda-Ṛddhiyukta-rāja;
the Buddha who addressed Sumeruprabha-rāja.
Dharmapāla Buddha,
Vajragarbha-siṃhavikrīḍita Buddha,
and Ratnajaya Buddha.
The Buddha of Supernatural Powers;
the Buddha Bhaiṣajyaguruvaiḍūryaprabharāja;
and the Buddha Samantaprabhāsa-guṇaparvatarāja.
The Buddha King of Jewels Well-Abiding in Merit;
the seven Buddhas of the past;
and the thousand Buddhas of the auspicious kalpa of the future.
One thousand five hundred buddhas;
ten thousand five hundred buddhas;
five hundred Flower-Supreme Buddhas.
The names of ten billion Vajragarbha Buddhas,
Dīpaṃkara Buddha,
and the six Buddhas of the six directions.
In the east is the Buddha King of the Sublime Sound of the Moon, in the Palace of Jewel Light;
in the south is the Buddha King of Tree-Root Flower Sovereignty;
and in the west is the Buddha King of the Flame-Flower of Black Sovereign Supernatural Powers.
In the north is the Buddha Pure Moon Palace;
above are the countless Buddhas Jewel Head of Diligence;
below is the Buddha King of the Sound of Virtuous Tranquility and Moon.
The immeasurable Buddhas,
the Buddha Prabhūtaratna,
and Śākyamuni Buddha.
Maitreya Buddha,
Akṣobhya Buddha,
and Amitābha Buddha.
All sentient beings throughout the center of the Buddha-worlds,
whether walking or dwelling upon the earth.
And while dwelling in the midst of space,
he regards all sentient beings with compassion,
causing each to find peace, security, and rest.
Practicing day and night,
one should constantly seek to recite this sutra;
it can extinguish the suffering of birth and death.
To extinguish and subdue all poisonous harms:
Namo to the Great Mantra Avalokiteśvara;
to the Illuminating Avalokiteśvara.
Gao Ming Guanshiyin, Kaiming Guanshiyin,
and Bhaiṣajyarāja Bodhisattva.
Bodhisattva Bhaiṣajyarāja, Bodhisattva Mañjuśrī,
and Bodhisattva Samantabhadra.
The Bodhisattva Ākāśagarbha,
the Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha,
and hundreds of millions of bodhisattvas from the Cool Jewel Mountain.
The Bodhisattva Huasheng, transformed by Tathāgata Pūrabhāsa,
recited this verse in every thought-moment for the seven World-Honored Buddhas.
Then he spoke the mantra, saying:
*Līlā līlāde, gauri gauride.*
Dhāraṇīte. Nikharate. Viliṇite.
Mahākāte. Jinlingqianti. Svāhā.
The Avalokiteśvaras of the ten directions and all the bodhisattvas have vowed to save sentient beings;

by calling their names, one is completely liberated. If there is a person of wisdom who diligently explains this for others, provided there is the proper cause and condition, they shall read and recite it without ceasing until they have completed a thousand repetitions.
With every thought, the mind remains uninterrupted; flames cannot harm it. Swords and weapons are instantly shattered;
from anger, joy is born. The dead are transformed into the living. Do not say this is false:
the High King Avalokiteśvara is able to rescue one from all suffering and peril when facing urgent crisis and hardship.
The dead shall become alive; the words of the Buddhas are not false. Therefore, one should pay homage and recite this one thousand times;
all grave sins will be extinguished. Those of meager merit who lack faith should single-mindedly offer up the upholding of this sutra and the recitation of the names of the eight great bodhisattvas.
Homage to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Avalokiteśvara.
Homage to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Maitreya.
Homage to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Gaganagañja.
Homage to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Samantabhadra.
Homage to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi.
Homage to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Mañjuśrī.
Homage to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Sarvanīvaraṇaviṣkambhin.
Homage to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Kṣitigarbha-rāja.
Homage to all the venerable Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas.
May these merits be universally shared with all beings;
Having recited this one thousand times, All heavy transgressions shall be extinguished.
The *Buddha-spoken Sutra of the High King Avalokiteśvara* is hereby concluded.
